title: Big sellers: automatic payments, packing and running a busy shop on NukkadSale
description:
Fifty orders on a single drop? This video shows how NukkadSale runs a busy WhatsApp shop: automatic payments through your own Razorpay account, a clear packing queue, printable shipping labels, cash on delivery, delivery charges, carts, orders from chats, repeat buyers – and the full desktop view.

Razorpay charges its own fee for each payment.
